blockers.description: Repository ecs.php uses the removed legacy ECS configuration API and cannot run with locked ECS 13.2.19.
blockers.workaround: Use a temporary ECS 13 fluent config for touched files only; do not apply its unrelated formatting suggestions. PHP syntax lint, Twig/XLIFF lint and PHPStan already pass.

decisions.decision: Name the field user_barcode and expose it as API user_barcode.
decisions.rationale: Matches the existing opaque user-defined barcode property on PartLot and avoids UUID-specific naming.

decisions.decision: Use nullable VARCHAR(255), preserve whitespace, and canonicalize only the empty string to NULL.
decisions.rationale: Allows a portable full-field unique index while following PartLot form behavior for opaque whitespace-sensitive content.

decisions.decision: Resolve StorageLocation after PartLot within the existing USER_DEFINED scanner stage.
decisions.rationale: Preserves internal and PartLot barcode priorities and reuses LocalBarcodeScanResult navigation.
Unknown scans currently collapse to an exception/flash without a result object; location selection and state transfer would require a new non-small scanner UI flow.
